messages:
Maria: Heads up - nightly eval for ceres-7b-v2-quant spiked QA accuracy and CI failed. stack shows weird sentinel tokens in runner output. cc @Akhil @Sophia
CI Bot: CI failure: /ci/evals/nightly/1808888888 - exit code 1. Failed tests: eval_harness.tests.qa_regression.TestSanity.test_no_sentinels
Akhil: Can you paste the failing log lines? suspect tokenizer special token normalization.
Maria: log excerpt:
```
[eval-runner] output: 'User: Hello\x01'
[tokenizer] decoded: '<|sentinel_0|>'
metrics: qa_accuracy drops from 0.82 -> 0.45
```
Sophia: That \x01 is suspicious. Looks like vendor token merging in quantized ONNX export. We saw similar with k8s batch padding removing sentinel bytes.
Jamie: Runner also applies `log_scrub` step in CI. Might be overzealous, replacing non-utf8 bytes with sentinel tokens. Check eval_runner/config.py -> `scrub_nonprintable`.
Maria: Found it: `scrub_nonprintable=True` in CI override for nightly to reduce log noise. But it's called before tokenization in the pipeline for chat templates. So we lose sentinels used for reply delimiting.
Akhil: Possible fixes: a) move scrub after tokenization; b) adjust tokenizer to treat \x01 as valid separator; c) add unit test to prevent scrub before tokenization. Prefer c + b.
Sophia: Also quant could be folding KV cache keys causing mismatched tokens on decode. In quantized model we saw `decoder_v2` mapping change. Need a small reproducer.
Maria: I'll make reproducer and open GH issue. Repro steps: 
```bash
python -m eval_runner.run --model ceres-7b-v2-quant --chat-template default --input 'Hello\x01How are you?'
```
Jamie: CI workaround: revert scrub override for nightly until fix landed. I'll do rollback and trigger rerun.
CI Bot: Rollback PR merged: #4521. Rerunning nightly job.
EvalRunner: Rerun complete: job 1808888899. Result: failing tests reduced, qa_accuracy back to baseline on CPU models, quantized still 0.63. Logging more info to /var/logs/eval/1808888899.log
Akhil: If quant still low, run tokenizer compare: `tokenizer.encode_raw` vs `tokenizer.encode_for_model`. If mismatch then update tokenizer config `add_special_tokens` flag.
Maria: Opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/issues/1098 with reproducer, logs, suggested patches. Assigning to @Akhil and @Sophia. Adding dashboard alert to notice sudden drops >0.15 for qa_accuracy.
Sophia: :thumbsup: I'll investigate quant decode mapping, try ONNX export with `--preserve-special-bytes`.
Jamie: Also adding a CI guard: a small smoke test that tokenizes raw chat templates and asserts no `<|sentinel` tokens in intermediate JSON. Will land in CI tomorrow.
Maria: Thanks all. keeping thread here for updates. tagging @oncall-eng-ml if rollback or hotfix needed.
